'''Kyle Ishimaru'''<ref name="dt-19374">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19374 WYS  Cali Style (No R3)], DeckTech (Kyle "Psyokid" Ishimaru, 16 October 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19374/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19374/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech and Game Players Network handle '''Psyokid'''<ref name="gpn-1716">[https://web.archive.org/web/20051102154456/http://gameplayersnetwork.com/card/decks.asp?gm=starwars&id=1716 We'll Handle WHAT?], Game Players Network (psyokid, 21 March 2002), Wayback Machine copy.</ref>) posted a [[Light]] [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Step]] list on DeckTech in October 2001. Ishimaru also published two constructed lists on [[Game Players Network]] in March 2002.
